core_meaning.primary_meaning: Lateefah corresponds to the Arabic form لطيفة and is glossed in this record as “Gentle, subtle.” The record associates the form with root ل ط ف (l-ṭ-f). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Lateefah corresponds to the Arabic form لطيفة (Arabic root ل ط ف (l-ṭ-f); لَطِيفَة (Laṭīfa)). Its core sense is gentle, subtle (feminine). Lateefah is Arabic لَطِيفَة (Laṭīfa) 'gentle, subtle' (feminine), from the root ل ط ف (l-ṭ-f). The source gloss 'Delicate, Tender' is broadly consistent. Same name as lateefa, latheefa, latifa and latifah.

persian.name: لطیفه
persian.long_meaning: Lateefah (لطیفه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن لطیفه، نرم (مؤنث) است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: لطيفة
arabic.long_meaning: Lateefah (لطيفة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي اللطيفة، الرقيقة، الكريمة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: In Urdu it is written لطیفہ and carries the sense “لطیفہ، نرم (مؤنث)”.

faq.a: Documented usage records Lateefah as a girl's name; actual use can vary by community.
